claim: Patchline ships an open-problem bounty board with gate-checkable success criteria, reproducible submissions, and payout-approved minimized reproductions for false negatives and high-impact ecosystem gaps. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every bounty has an approved payout, a minimized reproduction, and concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms both false-negative and ecosystem-gap bounties are eligible, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence and no payout, so the bounty workflow is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make open-problem-bounty-board-gate`.
